# Host reachability status icon shows "Reachable" for offline/unreachable hosts (false positives behind Zscaler/ZTNA), plus related bugs found and fixed along the way

## Summary

The connection tree (and a separate button in the Config panel) show a reachability icon
(online/offline) per connection, computed by `mRemoteNG/Tools/HostStatusMonitor.cs` (see issue
#1109). The original implementation determined reachability with a single, weak check: open a raw
TCP connection to the host's port and ...
